annotation.evidence_span: The endpoint MUST acknowledge packets containing only ACK or PADDING frames in the next ACK frame that it sends.
annotation.interpretation_a: The endpoint is required to include an acknowledgement of ACK/PADDING packets in the very next ACK frame it sends, regardless of other packets it might also acknowledge in that frame.
annotation.interpretation_b: The endpoint is required to include an acknowledgement of ACK/PADDING packets *eventually* in an ACK frame, but not necessarily the very next one; it can batch acknowledgements as usual.
annotation.justification: The phrase "next ACK frame" is ambiguous. Does it mean the very next ACK frame sent, or the next ACK frame in the sequence of ACK frames? The two interpretations lead to different implementation behaviours.
